name: loginter.com.ar
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.
lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
summary: The start page is larger than 2 MB, so the review analyzed its first 2 MB. www.loginter.com.ar scores 58 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 40 pass. Fix first: the website link on the Google Business Profile leads to an error.

fix.title: The website link on the Google Business Profile leads to an error
fix.evidence: The profile's website link could not be read (The page is larger than the review limit.).
fix.fix: Point the profile's website field at a live page of www.loginter.com.ar, or redirect the old address to one.

vars.error: The page is larger than the review limit.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /faq. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /nosotros, /por-que-nos-eligen, for example .RXCM8H[aria-label="Más páginas de Personas"][data-part="dropdown-button"] and #comp-mgusmk101_r_comp-morjqzzl > .font_9 > a[target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: axios 0.21.4 has known flaws
fix.evidence: axios 0.21.4 (banner of /_partials/wix-thunderbolt/dist/clientWorker.da07f111.bundle.min.js): 24 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2023-45857, CVE-2025-27152, CVE-2026-25639. Axios does not correctly normalize hostnames when checking…
fix.fix: Upgrade axios to 1.6.8 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.
